svg.text: XGIMI TITAN Noir control bridge — wiring
ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 (dual USB-C). All links 115200 8N1, no flow control.
One cable, plus an LED for Test 6. Answers: does the projector see the ESP32 at all, and will its serial daemon bind?
aim at the rear panel, ~30 cm
Both projector USB ports in use, so the project is not betting on a single driver binding. The ESP32 runs from its own supply and stays awake when the projector sleeps.
Measure the CH340's TXD to GND before wiring it.
A module set to 3.3 V may still idle its TXD at 5 V, and the ESP32-S3 is not 5 V tolerant.
If it reads ~5 V, divide that one line: 1k from TXD to GPIO18, 2k from GPIO18 to GND.
